Sales of new single-family homes rose to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 684,000 in August, up 6.4% from July's revised 643,000 but 2.0% below the same month last year. summary: Mortgage demand remained subdued last week as the 30-year fixed rate climbed above 7%. title: タイの生命保険市場（2025年版）
